purpose: Machine-readable release gates for Tobin Clearing Protocol (experimental MVP-1). A gate is PASS only when this file records the required approval or evidence AND the cross-checks in scripts/release/check-gates.mjs agree with the repository state. Absent fields, existing files and zero scan findings never turn a gate into PASS. This file does not authorize anything by itself; publication always needs a recorded approval under gate G11.

targets.private-remote-backup: push of the branch to a verified PRIVATE remote
targets.versioned-release: a tagged or versioned release with artifacts
targets.production: production or real-value deployment (not intended by this project today)

gates.name: Copyright holder and licensor authority confirmed
gates.evidence_required: Written confirmation (registration documents or an explicit owner decision) of who actually holds the copyright and the authority to license, including any contributor or third-party material, reviewed by qualified counsel. A founder-provided assertion of ownership is not independent verification.
gates.founder_assertion: The founder states that they are the founder and claim ownership of the project (recorded as a founder-provided assertion). It has not been independently verified, and it does not verify other contributors' rights, third-party rights, or the provenance of every file. Tobin Protocol is not yet formally registered.

founder_decision.decision: Intended copyright holder designation: "tobin-protocol". Intended copyright notice: "Copyright 2026 tobin-protocol". Applied to the Apache-2.0 appendix of LICENSE.
founder_decision.nature: founder decision; not a legal review; not a statement that a legal entity named tobin-protocol exists or is registered
founder_decision.gate_effect: none: this gate stays BLOCKED until qualified legal review and confirmation of the rights holder are recorded under approval and legal_review

gates.attestation: The founder attests that they own or control the material they are licensing (the code and the documentation and specification they own or control in this repository) and that they know of no competing claim. "tobin-protocol" is a copyright designation, not a registered legal entity. No legal review was performed; contributor and third-party rights beyond the founder's knowledge are not verified.

policy_changes.title: Experimental source-only publication standard
policy_changes.description: For the first public source release of the experimental MVP-1 only: (a) legal-kind gates G01, G05 and G08 may be approved on the founder's own attestation (review_standard "founder-attestation") instead of a qualified counsel review; (b) the full dependency attribution gate G04 and the hosted-evidence gates E01 and E05 are removed from the public-source-release requirements and replaced by the source-only dependency standard G12; (c) each approval made under this standard is valid only for public-source-release (valid_for), so versioned-release and production keep their full requirements and need fresh approvals. No legal review took place and none is claimed; hosted CI has not run; branch protection is unverified.
limits: Founder attestation is not independent verification and not legal advice.
The weaker assurance is accepted by the founder for an experimental source-only release and does not apply to binaries, Wasm releases, packages or any real-value use.
Hosted CI and branch protection remain recommended follow-ups (E01, E05) and are still required for versioned-release and production.
